thread:
sara: Quick heads-up — NovaHealth POC kickoff is tomorrow 10:00am PT in #sales (they joined the channel). Need to lock success criteria and surface any enterprise blockers now. Top asks: use cases, sample prompts/evals, expected traffic, security questionnaire gaps, and pricing runway. @darren @priya can you bring a recommended config (hosted vs dedicated) and an initial cost estimate?

darren: On it. Quick Q: do they expect batch embedding jobs or low-latency chat-style inference? A rough TPS/RPS helps sizing.

sara: They said primary is patient triage chat (latency-sensitive) + nightly batch summarization of notes. Estimate: ~30k chats/month, peak concurrency ~20rps, median prompt length ~120 tokens, response ~180 tokens.

priya: Thanks — that profile points to a mixed strategy. For chat latency SLO we should propose hosted with pinned model variant first (redwood-13b-q4 or equivalent) and recommend Dedicated if they need sustained >50rps or strict isolation. I'll bring 2 configs: "fast-hosted" and "reserved-dedicated" with 95th p50/p95 latency and monthly cost buckets.

maria: FYI security checklist highlights: SOC2 in progress, need SSO (SAML/OIDC), data residency options, and KMS integration for Private. Also ask: do they want PII scrubbers in the pipeline or do we hand back raw text? We need answers before we finalize onboarding.

sara: They want us to redact PHI client-side first, but would like optional server-side scrubber. Can we include an optional PII-scrub pipeline as an add-on in the POC?

darren: Yes — we can demo a host-side preprocessor in the POC. I'll bring a config snippet for the scrubber. Example snippet to show them:

```
# preprocessor example (pseudo)
pipeline = [
  "client_redact_physical_ids",
  "pii_regex_filter",
  "mask_tokens: true"
]
```

priya: For evals — propose 3 buckets: 1) safety & hallucination tests (10 prompts), 2) clinical accuracy spot-checks (20 cases with ground truth), 3) UX satisfaction (10 human-rated sessions). Metrics: factuality score, clinical F1, median latency, and human NPS. Who owns prompt set creation? @sara?

sara: I'll own the prompt/ground-truth collection with their clinical SME. ETA EOD Monday for initial draft.

darren: For rollout policy, recommend canary to 5% traffic then 25% then full. Add automatic fallback to smaller model variant if latency degrades >20% or error rate >1%.

maria: Security asks I'll surface to them tomorrow: link to questionnaire + three quick items to confirm pre-kickoff: SSO authority, retention TTL, and whether logs can contain redacted user ids only. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/nova-q1 (placeholder)

priya: Pricing question they'll ask: free trial credits vs committed Dedicated pricing. Proposed line: 2-week hosted trial (tiered token cap) + optional 3-month reserved capacity pilot with capped monthly spend. I'll bring a slide with unit economics per 1M tokens and an example bill.

sara: Can we agree success criteria so we can measure go/no-go at end of POC? My proposal:
- Functional: chat answers >= 85% clinical accuracy on test set
- Reliability: p95 latency <= 300ms for chat at normal load (20rps)
- Cost: estimated cost per chat <= $0.012 (token-based)
- Security: SSO in place and KMS or documented data handling flow
If all 4 met -> recommend expand to Dedicated within 30 days.

darren: Those look good. For the latency target I want to set an alternate: p95 <= 450ms on hosted if we don't get dedicated; note that quantization and KV caching will help.

maria: Add a security pass/fail: critical findings in questionnaire must be "no" or mitigated during POC. We'll need a signed NDA addendum for access to production-like PHI examples.

priya: Agenda for kickoff (10am PT):
- 10:00 — intros & goals (Sara)
- 10:10 — use-case walk-through & data types (Nova)
- 10:25 — tech plan, models, and infra recommendation (Darren)
- 10:40 — security checklist & next steps (Maria)
- 10:50 — success criteria & timelines (Priya/Sara)
- 11:00 — action items and calendar invites

sara: Adding action items now: 
- Sara: deliver prompt & eval list by Mon EOD
- Darren: bring config + scrubber demo + cost deltas by kickoff
- Priya: pricing slide and rollout plan by kickoff
- Maria: send questionnaire and required access checklist by kickoff

calendar-bot: Event created: "NovaHealth POC Kickoff" — tomorrow 10:00am PT — attendees: @sara @darren @priya @maria — meeting link included.

priya: Anything else? If not, I'll produce the 2 config options and a 1-page summary slide we can drop in the kickoff thread before the meeting.

sara: Perfect. If they bring sample anonymized transcripts before the meeting we can pre-run some evals — ask Nova to share a 50-row sample.

darren: I'll prep a short load-test script to run during POC: target 20rps for 10m and report p50/p95.

maria: I'll also flag the legal team about the NDA addendum.

sara: Great teamwork — see you all tomorrow.
